content: Who is Sonar? Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable. Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code. We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like: SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform. SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair. SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective. Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, San Mateo (California), Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE: Committed to our customers and community. Obsessed with quality. Deliberate in our decisions. Effective as one team. With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you. Position description Sonar is looking for a Global Benefits Manager to own the design, administration, and continuous improvement of our benefits programs across all of our global hubs. You'll ensure our benefits offerings are competitive, compliant, and reflective of the diverse needs of our employees across regions, while managing vendor relationships and driving process efficiency.

content: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. Position description: We are looking for an experienced BD and partnership professional to join Sonar as the Head of Technology Partnerships, SDLC. In this role, you will lead our efforts to forge and cultivate relationships with leading players in the traditional and emerging agentic SDLC, develop and drive marketing and co-sell programs, and grow our product collaboration with these players to help Sonar become a preferred partner in the DevOps ecosystem. With the partnerships you forge and develop, you will improve our ability to grow new customer adoption and deliver tangible improvements to existing customers.

Position description Identity is a critical dependency for how Sonar works. Our people need reliable access to the right systems, while the business needs confidence that access is appropriate, traceable, and removed when it is no longer required. As a Staff Identity and Access Management (IAM) Engineer in our Systems Engineering squad, you will design, build, and operate the identity services that connect our workforce, enterprise applications, and infrastructure. You will combine deep technical expertise with hands-on engineering to make identity secure, reliable, and straightforward to use. You will shape the technical direction of workforce IAM, turn complex access requirements into maintainable engineering solutions, and lead initiatives from design through production operation. Your scope includes employee and external-worker identity lifecycles, authentication and federation, access governance, privileged access, and the non-human identities supporting our internal services and automation. This is a technical leadership role without direct people-management responsibilities. Position description Sonar is looking for a customer-centric Identity Product Manager to drive the authentication, authorization, and access management capabilities that let every user, from an individual developer to the largest regulated enterprise, get into Sonar products securely and without friction. You will work with the Identity squad, in the Storefront domain, which provides the operational foundation enabling seamless customer access to Sonar's products, underpinning core business processes such as billing and entitlement. This role sits at the intersection of customer experience, security, and compliance. As a Product Manager, you will shape how organizations authenticate into Sonar (SSO via SAML/OIDC, with enterprise identity providers such as Okta and Entra ID), how permissions and roles are managed at scale, and how user and organization identities are provisioned and kept secure throughout their lifecycle.
